crop: full body, top18% masked, aspect-preserving neutral padding
visual_finetune: last transformer block and final norm; first11 blocks frozen
loss: tracklet identity cross-entropy + same-team hard triplet margin0.3
augmentation: temporal sub-selection plus embedding dropout0.05; no pixel augmentation after frozen-prefix cache
visual_selection: 0.7 VAL same-team weighted-tracklet mAP +0.3 VAL same-team crop mAP
scorer: L2 logistic regression, train only; VAL threshold max recall under empirical same-team FMR<=0.01; no TEST tuning
geometry: existing provided nonlinear keypoint interpolation; unknown uncertainty and true visibility represented as missing
evaluation: M10 crop protocol unchanged, plus identical M11 8–12-frame tracklets for all models
integration: requires representation gains without unsafe shadow merges; otherwise leave production M9 active
